simple.meaning: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קָפַץ (H7092) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קָפַץ (qâphats) means to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet) First listed occurrence: Deut 15 7.

definitions.short: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
definitions.usage: shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.
definitions.full: H7092. qaphats קָפַץ verb draw together, shut (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic collect, conjoin, tie ; Syriac draw together, contract, withdraw (compare Nö M 47: ZMG xxxiii (1879), 516 ); קְפַץ ᵑ7 hasten (double oneself up in running), Pi`el hop, spring ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ק Psa 77:10 , etc.; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּקְמֹּץ Deut 15:7 ; 3 masculine plural יִקְמְּצוּ Isa 52:15 ; — shut hand Deut 15:7 (with מִן away from , so as not to lend; opp, פתח Deuteronomy 15:80); mouth, in astonishment Isa 52:15 , in abject silence Job 5:16 ; Psa 107:42 ; figurative ׳ק רַחֲמָיו 77:10 shut up his compassion. Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular יִקָּֽפְצוּן Job 24:24 si vera lectio, they draw themselves together , of contraction in death (compare Di Bu; Ol יִקָּֽבְצוּן are gathered in ). Pi`el Participle עַלהַֿגְּבָעוֺת מְקַמֵּץ Song 2:8 springing (i.e. making repeated contractions of body, in taking leaps) upon the hills (|| מְרַלֵּג ). קֵץ see קצץ .
